name: ASBO Matrix
description: All Star bulk quantity pricing matrix and cart-synced single-product quantity controls for WooCommerce product templates.
changelog:
0.2.1

  • Fixes WordPress editor discoverability for All Star Single Product Quantity.
  • Removes the restrictive ancestor rule that could hide the block from normal block search.
  • Explicitly registers the All Star Embroidery block category as a fallback.
  • Adds quantity/cart/bulk search keywords and refreshes editor asset versions.
  • Best placed inside WooCommerce Add to Cart + Options (Beta) so the control follows the selected variation.
